title: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now supports direct querying of Apache Iceberg and Parquet data in your data lake
summary: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL now lets you directly query Apache Iceberg and Parquet data stored in your data lake alongside live operational data—no ETL pipelines required.
